page: Amazon Web Services r9g.8xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by custom AWS Graviton arm64 processors. It features 32 dedicated physical cores running at 3.3 GHz with a single thread per core, ensuring consistent compute performance without hyperthreading overhead. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per physical core. It runs on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, which offloads virtualization functions to dedicated hardware to maximize resource availability for the guest operating system.

This instance does not include local NVMe storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 17 Gbps. Built on the energy-efficient Graviton arm64 architecture, the r9g.8xlarge offers a cost-efficient profile for memory-intensive workloads compared to traditional x86 architectures, delivering high resource density and memory capacity per allocated compute unit.

Given its 256.0 GB memory capacity and 32 dedicated cores, the r9g.8xlarge is designed for memory-intensive applications. Suitable workloads include in-memory databases, large-scale caching layers, distributed data stores, real-time analytics, and enterprise applications requiring high memory-to-CPU ratios without the need for local physical storage or GPU acceleration.
